verdict.rationale: Sketch's AI page covers only one of the four named chores: replacing placeholder text with context-aware content [sketch-docs-39], which roughly matches copy suggestions. The other AI-adjacent features are tangential to asset work: palette-from-photo, layer tidying and dark-mode swaps. They also appear to run through an external MCP-connected AI client [sketch-docs-18, sketch-docs-49] rather than a native built-in model. Missing for 10: image generation, background removal, content-aware fill, evidence that the AI is native to the editor rather than bring-your-own client, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
